body.purpose: Running text, inputs, buttons, record cells; 68ch measure.

label.purpose: Form labels, column heads, fact terms, tabs, the key, state words, quiet and stamp buttons.

small.purpose: Role labels; stacked field names on phone records.

figures.purpose: Identifiers and codes in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono; records use tabular-nums.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Lifts every block off the ground.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: What sits over the page: an open dialog, a Course block under the pointer.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Every colour, border and background transition.

motion.name: seal-slide
motion.purpose: View transition sliding the current-section row to the new section; the page swaps in place.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: A dialog rising 8px into place; dropped under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: The one breakpoint (a zoomed desktop reaches it too): the sidebar folds into a top header with sections as a three-column grid, the key moves below the record, tables stack into entries.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--action); border: 1px solid var(--action); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--on-action); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 90ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--action-strong); border-color: var(--action-strong); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The second action beside a first: outlined, not filled.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 20px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--action); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--action-wash); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--action) 55%, transparent); color: var(--action-strong); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Head actions such as Sign out, and pager steps.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 14px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--action-wash); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--action) 55%, transparent); color: var(--action-strong); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stamp Button
components.description: An action that takes something away: alarm as text and outline, never a fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 14px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm) 55%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--alarm); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-stamp:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm) 10%, transparent); border-color: var(--alarm); } .ds-btn-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--alarm); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Held Button
components.description: Disabled: dashed outline and softened words, never mistaken for a quiet button.
components.css: .ds-btn-held { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 20px; background: transparent; border: 1px dashed var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 10px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-soft) 80%, transparent); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, surface well, indigo border on focus.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; color: var(--ink); } .ds-input { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 9px 12px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input:hover:not(:focus) { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 40%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--action); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Sidebar navigation
components.description: Grouped sections in the sidebar; the current one on an indigo-washed row that slides between rows.
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 15rem; padding: 12px; background: var(--rail); } .ds-h { margin: 0 0 4px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-nav ul { display: grid; gap: 2px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: var(--wash); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { background: var(--action-wash); color: var(--action-strong); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: School Switcher
components.description: The other Schools, opened under the button that offers them.
components.html:
Switch School
  • Hillcrest Primary
  • All your Schools
components.css: .ds-switcher { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-switcher summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switcher summary::after { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-right: 2px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor; transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg); } .ds-switcher[open] summary::after { transform: translateY(2px) rotate(-135deg); } .ds-switcher summary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 40%, transparent); } .ds-switcher ul { margin: 6px 0 0; padding: 4px 0; min-width: 14rem; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 10px; list-style: none; } .ds-switcher li a { display: block; padding: 8px 16px; color: var(--action); text-decoration: none; } .ds-switcher li a:hover { background: var(--action-wash); } .ds-switcher li:last-child { margin-top: 4px; padding-top: 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }

components.name: State Marks
components.description: State as a word with a disc: filled, ringed, struck. Never colour alone.
components.html: May read Unclaimed May not read
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-right: 16px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-mark::before { content: ''; width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-mark--filled, .ds-mark--open { color: var(--action); } .ds-mark--filled::before { background: var(--action); border-color: var(--action); } .ds-mark--open::before { border: 2px solid var(--action); } .ds-mark--struck::before { border-color: var(--ink-soft); background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent calc(50% - 0.75px), var(--ink-soft) calc(50% - 0.75px) calc(50% + 0.75px), transparent calc(50% + 0.75px)); }

components.name: Record
components.description: A ruled table in tabular figures; soft-ink heads over a rule, faint rules between rows.
components.css: .ds-record { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); } .ds-record th { padding: 0 12px 8px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-record td { padding: 12px 12px 12px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-record tbody tr:hover { background: var(--wash); } .ds-id { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; }

components.name: Slip
components.description: An issued record or the one modal overlay: surface, rule border, 16px corner, block shadow (lift shadow when it is the dialog).
components.html:
End this membership?

Morgan Reyes will no longer hold School Administrator here.
components.css: .ds-slip { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 24px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);  color: var(--ink); } .ds-slip h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-slip p { margin: 0; } .ds-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; } .ds-slip-stamp { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 14px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm) 55%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--alarm); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-slip-ghost { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 20px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--action); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Notice, Error, Empty
components.description: Seal-washed notice; error named in words over an alarm wash; empty record in a dashed box.
components.html:
Access profiles take effect on the next page a Guardian opens.

That Invitation has already been used.

No Invitations are open.
components.css: .ds-notice { max-width: 68ch; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--action-wash); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--action) 25%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-error { padding: 10px 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm) 9%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm) 45%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--alarm); font-weight: 600; } .ds-empty { padding: 32px 16px; border: 1px dashed var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink-soft); text-align: center; }

narrative.overview: Every School runs on the week pinned in the staff room: each Course a coloured block, the grid between them white. A quiet grey ground carries white blocks lifted by one soft shadow; each Course owns one of six saturated colours and keeps it wherever its Class Offerings appear; indigo marks what can be acted on and where you are. Inside a School the shell is a sidebar, and the sheet fills the rest of the window at any width.
rules: The Course Colour Rule: a Course colour means that Course and nothing else.
The Neutral Reading Rule: running text sits on surface or ground; only a Course block puts white words on colour.
The Two Renditions Rule: every colour is a token with a light and a dark value.
The Fixed Ramp Rule: type grows only with the reader's zoom, never with the window.
